messages:
Maya: quick check — if we deprovision a user who is the sole owner of a SCIM-mapped group, do we currently transfer ownership automatically or can groups end up ownerless? hitting this in an offboard dry-run.
Sam: owners can end up ownerless today if the owner is removed via SCIM delete. we don't have an automatic transfer in the base flow.
Kevin: +1. SCIM requests map to Google groups roles; removing owner membership removes that role. there is a separate owner-transfer helper we implemented for a while but it was gated behind a flag and not enabled everywhere.
Maya: ok. two follow-ups: 1) do we emit an event when owner is removed? 2) logs currently include full email addresses — security wants redacted audit logs for PII.
Jordana: we emit an audit event: `scim.account.removed` with payload like `{"user":"alice@redwood.com","group":"eng-frontend","role":"owner"}`. yeah it contains emails.
Sam: redaction is needed. minimal change: redact localpart in logs, keep a user_id and hashed_email for lookup. e.g. `user: <redacted>@redwood.com, user_id: u_12345, email_sha256: abcdef...`
Kevin: implementation note: provisioning-service writes to both realtime event bus (kafka) and long-term audit bucket. we should do redaction before writing to the auditable storage. realtime can have full for immediate rollback, but bucket must be PII-redacted/encrypted.
Jordana: suggested regex for redaction during serialization: ```s/^([^@]+)@(.+)$/<redacted>@$2/``` or better: store `email_hash=sha256(email)` and only `email_redacted=<redacted>@domain` in plain text.
Maya: sounds good. also on the owner-transfer helper: does it pick a fallback owner automatically (e.g., team maintainers group) or require a manual assignment?
Kevin: current helper tries these steps: 1) pick fallback owner from group metadata `fallback_owner_id` if present, 2) else pick first existing member with role "maintainer" then escalate to team leads. it's heuristics — racey if deprovision happens simultaneously.
Sam: to make this safe for prod we need: feature flag + canary rollout + security review (since it implies SCIM write scopes eg: `groups.write`).
Maya: what's the approval path to flip the flag? who needs to sign off?
Jordana: sec review required (changes to PII handling + owner-transfer behavior). product sign-off for UX and infra eng for rollout plan. add label `sec:scim-owner-transfer` on the PR.
Sam: i'll open the PR. will include tests: unit for redaction, e2e `offboard-owner-transfer` test. tagging @Kevin for infra review and @Jordana for sec.
Kevin: also add a DB migration to persist `fallback_owner_id` on groups. otherwise helper won't have a stable tracer.
Maya: noted. i'll add migration in the PR. can someone confirm exact logging retention bucket + KMS key so we can include in the security checklist?
Jordana: retention: 365 days in `audits-prod` bucket, KMS key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/audit/cryptoKeys/audit-v1`. we'll include rotation checklist.

oncall-bot: Deploy scheduled: provisioning-service -> staging at 2026-03-18T02:00Z (triggered by Sam) :information_source:
Maya: thanks all. i'll start the PR with the redaction patch + feature flag + tests. ping back here when reviewers are added. :eyes:
